page_title: SAS 1-0 FRO | Sassuolo v Frosinone 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Federico La Penna has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+4' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Andrea Consigli made an astonishing save!
90+4' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+4' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
90+2' The referee points to the corner flag and Frosinone will take a corner.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) fails to convert the penalty kick. His shot goes just wide of the left post.
90' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
89' Federico La Penna blows for a foul after Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Frosinone are awarded a penalty kick!
88' Good team movement sets up Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
85' The corner is swung in but Frosinone can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
84' A substitution has been made. Matias Soule goes off and Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) comes on.
84' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Walid Cheddira and he is replaced by Kaio Jorge (Frosinone).
83' Davide Ballardini has decided to make a change. Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marash Kumbulla (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch for Nedim Bajrami.
82' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
81' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Federico La Penna has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
80' Matias Soule (Frosinone) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
80' Matias Soule (Frosinone) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
76' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
73' Yellow card. Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
73' Substitution. Gregoire Defrel did his best and is replaced by Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo).
71' Marash Kumbulla (Sassuolo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
69' Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
69' Federico La Penna has a clear sight and sees a foul from Walid Cheddira (Frosinone).
68' Referee Federico La Penna sees the trip by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
66' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
63' The game has come to an end for Kristian Thorstvedt. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo).
63' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Marco Brescianini is replaced by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone).
63' The substitution has been made. Demba Seck (Frosinone) has replaced Fares Ghedjemis.
63' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
60' Andrea Consigli is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Nadir Zortea (Frosinone). Easy save!
58' 1 - 0 Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
57' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Frosinone! Play can continue.

54' Play continues despite the shouts by some Frosinone players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Federico La Penna interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
52' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
50' Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
48' Matias Soule (Frosinone) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Federico La Penna blows for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
41' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andrea Consigli intercepts the ball.
38' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
37' The game is interrupted now, Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Rough tackle by Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Andrea Consigli is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone). Easy save!
34' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Josh Doig (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

29' Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
27' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andrea Consigli, who smothers the ball.
23' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
23' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
22' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
21' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) commits a rough foul. Federico La Penna stops the game and makes a call.
20' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo will have a throw-in.
17' 1:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
14' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sassuolo.
11' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) does well to connect with the resulting set piece, but his shot flies miles wide of the left post.
10' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Emanuele Valeri is being substituted because of an injury. Eusebio Di Francesco sends Pol Lirola (Frosinone) on the pitch.
8' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
4' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Frosinone will kick the game off.
Federico La Penna is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
